name: Jade Revival
effect: Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 4. If the chanting roll was 8+, return a number of slain models to the target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 8 instead.
declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
